content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: the Apply button on sales invoice:new gives no visible response after the first click, since no navigation, overlay, or error event follows the repeated Apply clicks (279, 283, 287, 290, 294 in S806b5d05; 279, 284, 287, 291, 294 in S3a99876d; 280, 285, 288, 292, 295 in Sf6922579), so users click again at nearly the same spot.", "fix": "Fix: On the Apply button in the sales invoice:new Taxes Section, disable the button and show a pending/spinner state immediately on the first click, and re-enable it only when the tax update finishes, so repeat clicks are blocked and the response is visible.", "cited_event_ids": ["279", "283", "287", "290", "294", "284", "291", "280", "285", "288", "292", "295"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["Whether the Apply handler runs or completes at all; the event stream has no record of app-side state changes.", "The visual state of the Apply button between clicks (no style, disabled, or loading events are recorded).", "Whether Apply is inside the Taxes Section; the nearby pointer label suggests it but the element's parent is not confirmed.", "Whether the repeated clicks are caused by the button's visual response or by something else; the cause rests on absence of events.", "Whether the 0.9 s\u20131.4 s burst leads to any eventual result; the outcome field reports no abandonment only."]}
